hero-description: InovaHD Blog. Essays, reflections, and experiments at the frontier of humanities and AI.
sobre-text:
Enhanced is the blog of InovaHD, an association created from LABHDUFBA (Digital Humanities Laboratory at UFBA). We publish essays, reflections, and experiments at the frontier of digital humanities and artificial intelligence.

Our goal is to create a high-quality editorial space, with texts between the blog post and the academic essay, accessible to a broad audience yet rigorous. The blog is a serial publication written and curated by LABHDUFBA members and maintained by InovaHD, presenting essays, reflections, and excerpts from ongoing research.

LABHDUFBA was founded in 2018, associated with the PPGCS and ICTI/UFBA, and registered in CNPq's Directory of Research Groups. Its research lines include digital humanities, disinformation, computational archival science, digital history, and the ethical implications of digital technoscience.
editorial-intro: The editorial board of Enhanced is responsible for curation and approval of published texts. Proofreading and revision are the authors' responsibility. Each text requires 3 approvals from the editorial board to be published.

normas-intro: Enhanced accepts submissions of texts between 500 and 4000 words, in Portuguese or English, on topics related to digital humanities, artificial intelligence, agents, disinformation, computational archival science, and related themes.
normas-format-text: Texts in markdown, between 500 and 4000 words. Include title, abstract up to 150 characters, and author name with institutional affiliation.
normas-process-text: After submission, the text is distributed to the editorial board, which evaluates curation and approves or rejects publication. Proofreading and revision are the authors' responsibility. With 3 approvals, the text is automatically published.
normas-languages-text: Texts are published in Portuguese and English. The author may write in either language; the version in the other language is generated and reviewed by the author before publication.
